en.text: They might've just been desperate for any chance to change.

original: 信号が変わるのを待ってます。

en.text: I'm waiting at the traffic lights.

original: アルジェは何もかも変わってしまった。

en.text: Everything has changed in Algiers.

original: 私たちの考えは変わってません。

en.text: We haven't changed our minds.

original: ここの街並みもすっかり変わってしまった。

en.text: Even the look of the streets here has completely changed.

original: トムが変わるわけないだろ。

en.text: Tom will never change.
Tom isn't going to change.
There's no way Tom will change.
There's no way Tom will ever change.

original: 新機種が出たのにスペックはほとんど変わってない。

en.text: A new model came out, but the specs aren't much different.

original: ネットで教育が大きく変わる可能性はあります。

en.text: The Internet can make a big difference in education.

original: 選挙が近くなると急にコメンテーターの論調が変わる。

en.text: Commentators' tones change as soon as the election is near.

original: 変わりたいって思った。

en.text: I thought I wanted a change.
I thought I wanted to change.

original: 街が変われば人も変わる。

en.text: If a town changes, people will change too.
When a town changes, people will change too.
